title: Device-targeted feature flags for telemetry ingestion
name: Telemetry flag client

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code loads and evaluates feature flags for devices? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The flag service is unreachable for ten minutes after the client has started successfully. How does isEnabled behave during that time?
choices: It returns the hard-coded defaults for every flag
It throws until the next successful refresh
It returns false for every flag
It keeps answering from the last successfully fetched snapshot

questions.prompt: A flag has `firmwareMin: "2.10.0"`. A device reports firmware "2.9.4". What does isEnabled return?
choices: false, because 9 < 10 in the second numeric segment
It depends only on the rollout bucket
true, because missing segments default to 0

questions.prompt: Why does start() call `this.timer.unref()` on the refresh interval?
choices: So the refresh timer alone does not keep the Node.js process alive during shutdown
So refreshes run on a separate thread
So that refresh failures are not logged
To make the interval fire immediately
